claim.statement: GitLab's current execution documentation says a UI-started flow uses CI/CD: the runner downloads @gitlab/duo-cli, the CLI connects by WebSocket to the Duo Workflow Service, and the runner executes file and Git tools directed by the AI model.

values: runner can reach npm registry and Duo Workflow Service
AI model selected by namespace configuration

limitations: GitLab says the executor version is GitLab-managed and updated with regular releases, so this architecture does not pin a Duo CLI package or Workflow Service revision.
IDE-local flows are expressly outside this repository-integrated background-flow record.
unknowns: The @gitlab/duo-cli version, integrity digest, Workflow Service revision and tool protocol are unknown.
The runner image, network path and tool calls of any execution were not observed.
